notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration Version 0.8.9.0 Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/5b1682d6c53556967c5ac1678988b14660e476ed.png"][/img][/p][h1]Guardians Of Restoration has been updated to version 0.8.9.0.[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]Added 2 new sub weapons[/h3][p]Lightning Generator – Generates lightning to attack enemies. (Chain Lightning, Electric Orb skill tree)[/p][p]Turret Deployer – Installs turrets to attack approaching enemies. (Sniper Turret, Healing Zone skill tree)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/948cd09f2dfb7b348ea1efba8664767091702d05.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Sub Weapon Formation System[/h3][p]Previously, each robot had fixed sub weapon formations based on its main weapon. Now, you can customize your own sub weapon formations by directly changing the position and rotation on the 5 boards provided for each robot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/b40a73ab22e2f38088664102d05412bb4237a9a8.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/e7bc4dfad0c5f5887a885719a1101cb5b330b77e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Added Artifact and Circuit items[/h3][p]Bosses and enemies now drop Artifacts and Circuits upon defeat.[/p][p]Artifacts can include robot-specific and common skills. Equipping them can add or change a robot’s skills.[/p][p]Circuits apply their abilities when formation slots are connected on the formation board.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/5e2cbfe5e0625226dcbd2f12c8a1c40ee8189393.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Added Inventory[/h3][p]Artifacts and Circuits can now be upgraded and sold.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/dbbd6a08e0a36ee5cfe975995282be318c1613cf.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/3d413e4d96d6366601ec9cae3af658b44ae7b085.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][h3]Each robot’s first main weapon is unlocked from the start.[/h3][h3]Robot images have been added to the main screen.[/h3][h3]Information displayed on the pause screen has been updated.[/h3][h3]Boss HP gauge depletion effects have been added.[/h3][h3]Balance adjustments:[/h3][p]Special skills now apply Attack Power Increase and Damage Increase options, but their base attack power and scaling per level have been reduced.[/p][p]Enemy projectile-type attack coefficients have been increased, while melee attack coefficients have been reduced.[/p][p]Early-game boss attack power has been slightly increased, and late-game boss attack power has been slightly decreased.[/p][p]Enemy defense has been adjusted.[/p][p]Balance adjustments have been made to robot traits, main weapons, main weapon skills, sub weapons, sub weapon skills, and passive skills.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]Fixed various issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

tags.feature: Added 2 new sub weapons
Lightning Generator – Generates lightning to attack enemies. (Chain Lightning, Electric Orb skill tree)
Turret Deployer – Installs turrets to attack approaching enemies. (Sniper Turret, Healing Zone skill tree)
Sub Weapon Formation System

Previously, each robot had fixed sub weapon formations based on its main weapon. Now, you can customize your own sub weapon formations by directly changing the position and rotation on the 5 boards provided for each robot.
Added Artifact and Circuit items
Bosses and enemies now drop Artifacts and Circuits upon defeat.
Artifacts can include robot-specific and common skills. Equipping them can add or change a robot’s skills.
Circuits apply their abilities when formation slots are connected on the formation board.
Added Inventory
Artifacts and Circuits can now be upgraded and sold.
Each robot’s first main weapon is unlocked from the start.
Robot images have been added to the main screen.
Information displayed on the pause screen has been updated.
Boss HP gauge depletion effects have been added.

tags.balance_change: Special skills now apply Attack Power Increase and Damage Increase options, but their base attack power and scaling per level have been reduced.
Enemy projectile-type attack coefficients have been increased, while melee attack coefficients have been reduced.
Early-game boss attack power has been slightly increased, and late-game boss attack power has been slightly decreased.
Balance adjustments have been made to robot traits, main weapons, main weapon skills, sub weapons, sub weapon skills, and passive skills.

notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration DEMO v0.2.0.4 Update
notes.content:
1. Adjustments to the Code Eagle's Assault Rifle:
    - Increase the firing rate
    - Decrease the damage
    - Increase the ammunition capacity

2. Addition of Two Passive Skills for Code Eagle:
    - Opportunity Fire (When a critical hit occurs, fire a bullet at the targeted enemy)
    - Mark (When attacking an enemy with the primary weapon, if the enemy is attacked again with the primary weapon, deal area damage)

3. Remove the Passive Skill Limit on Level Up

4. Change  Upgrade Skills on Level Up

notes.title: Guardians of Restoration Demo Released!!
notes.content:
[b]Guardians of Restoration Demo[/b] Released!!

[b]Demo Features:[/b]
- You can progress through up to 5 out of the total 10 stages, encountering thrilling battles with 7 bosses.
- Playable with 'Code Eagle', equipped with an assault rifle as the primary weapon.

Users unfamiliar with action and bullet hell games may find the game somewhat challenging.
However, upgrades will be very helpful.

Upgrades can be performed in the hangar and shop from the main screen.
In the hangar, you can enhance the robot's stats, abilities, and main weapon.
At the shop, you can upgrade  sub weapons.

We hope many users will enjoy the game.
Thank you.
